name: Staked Axis USD
oneLiner: sUSDx is Axis's USDx rewards vault; vested rewards raise its share value, while exits require a cooldown and permissioned queue servicing.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact Ethereum StakedUSDx V2 implementation is an asset-backed USDx rewards wrapper. Its backing archetype follows the canonical synthetic-delta-neutral USDx parent; local share accounting and async exits are reviewed separately. The product predates V2: the legacy Plasma V1 Staked Axis USD (sUSDx) vault received the first 9,899,990.1 USDx tranche stake at Plasma block 18608029 (April 7, 2026, 05:31:32 UTC). The reviewed V2 implementation was activated at vault deployment on July 23, 2026, so its mechanism history does not inherit the private-beta product age.

sources.label: Legacy Plasma V1 sUSDx vault first tranche stake, April 7, 2026

collateral: Canonical USDx deposited into Axis's Ethereum StakedUSDx vault. Active principal and vested USDx rewards back outstanding shares; funded but unvested rewards and pending or claimable redemption liabilities are excluded from totalAssets and share pricing. Reward funding is discretionary and is not a mechanical pass-through of trading results. Upstream USDx portfolio, venue and hedge risks remain inherited.
pegMechanism: Users deposit USDx for ERC-4626 shares whose exchange rate rises as funded rewards vest. ERC-7540 requestRedeem burns shares and reserves USDx inside the vault; after the configured cooldown, a privileged servicer makes the request claimable. At Ethereum block 26197360 (October 15, 2026, 10:37:11 UTC), the cooldown was 604800 seconds; deposits, requests, servicing and claims were unpaused, but cancellations were paused. Seven days establishes eligibility, not a completion guarantee. previewRedeem and previewWithdraw revert because exits are asynchronous. Pending-request cancellation is available only when governance unpauses it and applicable restrictions permit it.

yieldConfig.yieldSource: Discretionary USDx rewards selected by Axis and vested into share value; no mechanical pass-through of trading results

notices.title: Pending-request cancellation was paused at the October 15 checkpoint
notices.message: At Ethereum block 26197360 (October 15, 2026, 10:37:11 UTC), the vault's redemption controls had pending-request cancellation paused. Requests, servicing and claims were unpaused. A pending request stops earning rewards and cannot be cancelled while cancellation stays paused. The seven-day cooldown establishes eligibility only; a privileged servicer must still make the request claimable. Check current contract state before requesting an exit.
